title: Measure the Sim-to-Real Gap: Designing an Affordable Real-World Benchmark Platform for Reinforcement Learning in AIoT Systems
abstract: arXiv:2607.10309v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is commonly employed to enhance the performance of autonomous systems, including the Autonomous Internet of Things (AIoT). However, the trial-and-error nature of RL, when conducted in real-world environments, is costly and hazardous in some scenarios. Consequently, the majority of RL research is conducted in simulation. This reliance introduces challenges related to the Sim-to-Real transferability. Evaluating the Sim-to-Real algorithmic robustness and the Sim-to-Real gap is a critical prerequisite for research aimed at improving RL performance in the real world. Therefore, industries such as robotics have developed concurrent simulation and physical platforms to facilitate this research. However, a universal Sim-to-Real benchmark platform for AIoT does not currently exist. To address these concerns, we developed a real-world AIoT platform for studying RL in AIoT. translated_title: 测量仿真到现实的差距：为AIoT系统中的强化学习设计一个经济实惠的现实世界基准平台
translated_abstract: 强化学习（RL）通常被用于提升自主系统的性能，包括自主物联网。然而，RL的试错特性在真实世界环境中进行时，在某些场景下成本高昂且具有危险性。因此，大多数RL研究是在仿真环境中进行的。这种对仿真的依赖带来了与仿真到现实迁移性相关的挑战。评估Sim-to-Real算法的鲁棒性以及Sim-to-Real差距，是旨在提升RL在现实世界中性能的研究的关键前提。为此，机器人等行业已经开发了并行的仿真与物理平台来促进此类研究。然而，目前尚不存在面向AIoT的通用Sim-to-Real基准平台。为了解决这些问题，我们开发了一个用于研究AIoT中强化学习的现实世界AIoT平台。在该平台上，部署在设备上的智能体可以……
tldr: 本文设计并构建了一个经济实惠的现实世界AIoT基准平台，用于测量和研究强化学习中仿真到现实的差距，填补了AIoT领域缺乏通用Sim-to-Real基准平台的空白。
en_tdlr: This paper designs and builds an affordable real-world AIoT benchmark platform to measure and study the Sim-to-Real gap in reinforcement learning, filling the gap of a universal Sim-to-Real benchmark platform in the AIoT field.
